description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data sources in the combined training set. The chart is divided into 12 slices, each representing a different data source. The slices are labeled with their corresponding data source names and percentage values, and are colored differently, although the exact shades are not distinguishable. The largest slice, labeled "NQ" and colored blue, accounts for approximately 31.3% of the total, while the smallest slice, labeled "SCIFACT" and colored yellow, represents about 0.1%. The other slices, in descending order of size, are "FEVER" (16.1%, teal), "SNLI" (15.4%, brown), "VITAMINC" (13.0%, green), "MULTINLI" (11.3%, red), "ANLI" (4.6%, dark green), "FACTCC" (2.6%, orange), "ENTFA" (1.8%, light green), "XSUMHUL" (1.6%, light brown), "SCITAIL" (1.2%, dark red), and "PUBHEALTH" and "MULTIFC" (both 0.5%, with PUBHEALTH in a darker shade and MULTIFC in a lighter shade). The chart does not include a legend, but the percentage labels are shown outside the slices, connected to their corresponding sections by lines. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded. The segments appear to be arranged in no particular order, with the largest slice, "NQ", positioned at the top-right of the chart.
